items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer asks 'What about -- wasn't Minor Hall a drummer?' and the interviewee responds 'Yeah. Let me tell you something about the drummer. The drummer that I had...'

ctx.x: What about -- wasn't Minor Hall a drummer?
Yeah. Let me tell you something about the drummer. The drummer that I had, he couldn't shuffle a drum around there. To play drums he had to play.
